function.name: list_transfer_recipients
function.description: Find distinct direct outgoing transfer recipients of account with amount >= min_amount. Order by recipient account; return account.

account.description: Account identifier from the user request.

min_amount.description: Inclusive minimum transfer amount in stored dataset units.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, after the documented ordering.

function.name: trace_transfer_reachability
function.description: Find outgoing transfer reachable accounts within max_hops (1 to 3), exclude starting account. Return account and minimum min_hops; order by account.

account.description: Account identifier from the user request.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, after the documented ordering.

function.name: trace_time_ordered_fund_paths
function.description: Find simple paths of exactly three outgoing transfers from account. Every edge meets min_amount and [start_ts,end_ts); timestamps must be nondecreasing. Return accounts arrays ordered lexicographically.

account.description: Account identifier from the user request.

min_amount.description: Inclusive minimum transfer amount in stored dataset units.

end_ts.description: Exclusive Unix timestamp in seconds; must exceed start_ts.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, after the documented ordering.

function.name: find_fan_in_accounts
function.description: Find recipients with at least min_senders DISTINCT senders during [start_ts,end_ts). Exclude self transfers. Return account, senders and total_amount; order by account.

end_ts.description: Exclusive Unix timestamp in seconds; must exceed start_ts.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, after the documented ordering.

function.name: find_linked_account_pairs
function.description: Find relationship-linked account pairs: a<b, transfer a to b, DISTINCT owners p and q with guarantee p to q, and a shared sign-in medium. Restrict lower account a to inclusive [account_min,account_max]. Return account_a,account_b ordered by these keys.

account_min.description: Account identifier from the user request.

account_max.description: Account identifier from the user request.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, after the documented ordering.

function.name: rank_linked_account_flows
function.description: Rank relationship-linked pairs (same relationship rules as find_linked_account_pairs) by BIDIRECTIONAL transfer sum, excluding either account with loan repayments. Restrict lower account a to inclusive [account_min,account_max]. Return account_a,account_b,total_amount; descending total then ascending IDs, top_k rows.

account_min.description: Account identifier from the user request.

account_max.description: Account identifier from the user request.

top_k.description: Maximum rows to return, after the documented ordering.

function.name: trace_rapid_pass_through
function.description: Find simple two-transfer paths from account through an intermediary to a different destination. Both amounts >= min_amount and timestamps in [start_ts,end_ts). Second timestamp minus first must be between 0 and max_gap_seconds inclusive. Return DISTINCT source, intermediary, destination ordered by these IDs. Investigation candidates, not proof of wrongdoing.

account.description: Account identifier from the user request.

min_amount.description: Inclusive minimum transfer amount in stored dataset units.

end_ts.description: Exclusive Unix timestamp in seconds; must exceed start_ts.

max_gap_seconds.description: Inclusive maximum delay in seconds between transfers.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, after the documented ordering.

function.name: find_shared_access_accounts
function.description: Find other accounts sharing a Medium with account, with both SIGN_IN timestamps in [start_ts,end_ts). Return DISTINCT account, shared_media count of distinct Medium nodes; order by account. Medium is a recorded access medium, not necessarily an IP or device; shared access does not prove common ownership.

account.description: Account identifier from the user request.

end_ts.description: Exclusive Unix timestamp in seconds; must exceed start_ts.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, after the documented ordering.
